Base directory for this skill: /home/yiket/Documents/noteapp/.claude/skills/next-task

# next-task

## 1. Select
- Take `next:` from the STATUS snapshot. `next: DONE` -> report completion and stop.
- `next: PNN REVIEW` -> go to section 8.
- Find the task block: Grep `^### <task-id>` in the current phase file, then Read only that block (offset/limit). Read the phase file header once per session for its goal and exit criteria.
- If the task depends on an unresolved Blocked item, take the next unblocked task in the same phase and note the skip in Handoff.

## 2. Load minimal context
- Read only the anchors in the task's `Read:` line (Grep the heading, Read that section).
- Read the code you will change. Use narrow Glob/Grep. Never read whole directories "to get a feel".

## 3. Plan briefly
- List files to create/modify and the tests you will add. If the change exceeds ~12 files or ~800 lines, split into sub-steps committed as `<task-id>a`, `b`, ... keeping the build green after each.

## 4. Implement
- Rules for the files you touch load automatically; follow them.
- Write tests alongside the code. For bugs: failing test first.

## 5. Verify
- Run every command in the task's `Verify:` line.
- Then for each touched module: `./gradlew :<m>:spotlessCheck :<m>:detekt :<m>:lintDebug :<m>:testDebugUnitTest` (JVM modules: `:<m>:test`, no lint).
- `device:` items: call the `device-tester` subagent with task id, build command, and a numbered list of checks (action, expected result, budget). Use its report as evidence.
- `user:` items: add to STATUS `USER-CHECK` as one line: `<task-id>: <what to open/do> -> <what good looks like>`. They do not block completion.
- If a check fails: fix and re-run. After 3 focused attempts without progress: section 9.

## 6. Commit
- `git add -A` then `git commit` with message `<type>(<scope>): <summary> [<task-id>]`.
- Body: changes in 1-5 lines; verification commands with results; `goldens updated: ...` if any; `amendments: ...` if any.

## 7. Update STATUS.md (same commit when possible)
- `next:` = following task id in phase-file order; after the last task: `next: PNN REVIEW`.
- Append the task id to the current phase progress line.
- Overwrite `Handoff` (<= 5 lines): state, anything half-done, the very next step.
- Keep STATUS <= 60 lines.

## 8. Phase REVIEW
1. Invoke the `reviewer` subagent with range `p<previous>-done..HEAD` (P00: whole history).
2. Fix every blocking finding (commits tagged `[PNN-REVIEW]`). Non-blocking findings: fix if cheap, else STATUS Deferred with id.
3. Run the full `./gradlew qa`. Run the maintain-memory compaction procedure.
4. `git tag pNN-done`. Collapse the phase to one line under `Completed` (date, tag, key numbers). Set `next:` to the first task of the next phase.

## 9. Stop conditions
- Headless session (started by run-loop.sh): stop after one task or one REVIEW, final message <= 3 lines.
- Interactive session: continue to the next task unless the user said otherwise; after an auto-compaction or 3 completed tasks, write Handoff and stop.
- Stuck after 3 attempts: record under `Blocked` (what failed, what was tried, what is needed), commit partial work on branch `wip/<task-id>` (not on main), switch back to main, continue with an independent task or stop.

7	Implements: R-INK-08
8	Read: 06-ink-input.md#wet-ink, 05-canvas-rendering.md#dry-handoff, decisions.md#adr-002-ink-stack

14	- Handoff: 3 screenshots right after a stroke ends; all must show the stroke.
15	Decision rule: handoff clean and `ink:onTouch` p95 <= 1 ms -> Accepted. No front buffer on HyperOS -> still Accepted (library falls back), note it in device.md.

A: 512 px ARGB_8888 tiles rendered on the render dispatcher with a software Canvas (CanvasStrokeRenderer if it supports software canvases, else stroke outline Paths). B: one RenderNode per tile with a compositing layer.
23	Measure (both): tile render time p50/p95 at zoom 1 and 3; `debugcmd.sh zoom-anim 1.0,3.0,800` and a scripted 10 s pan (finger swipes) with `gfxinfo.sh` jank % and p95 frame time; `diag.sh meminfo`; visual equality against a Roborazzi golden of the same page.
24	Decision rule: lowest jank with <= 1% janky frames; tie -> A (simpler, shared with export).
25	Output: ADR-003 evidence and decision.

28	Implements: R-TXT-03, R-TXT-08
29	Read: 07-text-engine.md#line-box, 07-text-engine.md#font-normalization, 07-text-engine.md#fonts
30	Question: Does a fixed line box plus per-font baseline correction put every baseline on the rule for all bundled fonts at all zoom levels?
31	Build: fetch the 20 fonts listed in 07-text-engine.md#fonts (OFL, from github.com/google/fonts) into `core/text/src/main/res/font/` with licenses in `core/text/src/main/assets/licenses/`. Instrumented test in `:core:text` laying out 3 paragraphs per font on a lined template (U = 7.1 mm) at zoom 1, 2, 4. Debug route `spike-fonts` shows all fonts on ruled paper.
32	Measure: max |baseline - ruleY| in px per font and zoom; cap-height error vs target; layout time per paragraph.
33	Decision rule: max error <= 0.5 px everywhere -> ADR-008 Accepted. Otherwise switch to per-line placement from TextLayoutResult metrics and re-measure.
34	Output: ADR-008 evidence; user: "Open spike-fonts. Do all fonts sit on the lines and look equally sized?"

37	Implements: R-TXT-02, R-TXT-04
38	Read: 07-text-engine.md#math, decisions.md#adr-007-latex-rendering
39	Question: Which native LaTeX renderer gives KaTeX-level coverage, exact metrics, speed, and vector output?
40	Options: A RaTeX Android binding (MIT, KaTeX-compatible Rust core, JNI Canvas rendering with depth metrics). B zly2006/latex (KMP Compose, pre-measure API). C ru.noties jlatexmath-android (GPL-2 with classpath exception).
41	Build: `MathRenderer` interface in core:text: `layout(latex, fontSizePx, color): MathBox(widthPx, ascentPx, depthPx)` + `draw(canvas, x, baselineY)`. One adapter per option. Corpus `testdata/math/corpus.txt` (40 formulas: fractions, roots, sums, integrals, limits, matrices, cases, aligned, Greek, accents, vectors, units, chemistry).
42	Measure: parse success rate; layout+draw p50/p95; metric accuracy (drawn ink bounds vs ascent/depth within 1 px); draws into a PdfDocument canvas as vectors (no bitmaps); APK size delta; license.

47	Implements: R-MED-01, R-FILE-03

50	Build: test code generates a 100-page vector PDF (PdfDocument: text, lines, a small image). PdfRasterizer prototype renders pages/tiles. Export prototype: overlay page drawn with PdfDocument (sample ink paths and text) merged onto original pages via PdfBox-Android `LayerUtility` (form XObject overlay), BouncyCastle excluded if unencrypted PDFs work without it.
51	Measure: first-page render ms; per-page raster p95 at 2 zoom levels; export time for 100 pages with overlays on 10; output size vs input; reopen output with PdfRenderer: page count, page sizes, pixel check at overlay location.

11	## ADR-002 Ink stack
12	Status: Accepted (2026-09-27, P01-S1)
13	Context: Wet ink must be as low-latency as possible (R-INK-08); strokes need pressure/tilt brushes, geometry for erasing and lasso, and stable rendering.
14	Options: A androidx.ink 1.1.0-alpha (newest alpha; public brush customization API, fixes since 1.0.0); B androidx.ink 1.0.0 stable (Dec 2025); C custom renderer on androidx.graphics front-buffered surfaces.
15	Decision: A, pinned to an exact alpha. Front-buffered wet ink via `InProgressStrokesView`, finished strokes via `CanvasStrokeRenderer`, geometry for erase/lasso. The experimental mesh-editing partial eraser (1.1.0-alpha05+) is not used because its results are not yet serializable; Folio splits stroke inputs instead (06-ink-input.md#erasers). Our file format stores our own `StrokeInputs`, not ink's serialization, so a library change never breaks files.
16	Fallback: B if an alpha regresses on the device; C only if the spike proves ink unusable on HyperOS.
17	Revisit: when ink 1.1.0 goes stable (move to stable).
18	Evidence 2026-09-27 (P01-S1): Pad 7, debug build, ink 1.1.0-alpha09, route `spike-ink` (pressure pen, CanvasStrokeRenderer page, DisplayModeHelper), 50 synthetic `input stylus swipe` strokes per run (400 ms, 50 events each). Median of runs, worst in brackets.
19	| Handoff mode | Runs | `ink:onTouch` p50 / p95 / max ms | `ink:handoff` p50 / p95 ms | Janky frames | 3 screenshots after pen-up |
20	|---|---|---|---|---|---|
21	| commit (ViewTreeObserver frame-commit callback) | 3 | 0.20 / 0.28 (0.29) / 0.55 (0.63) | 6.4 / 8.8 (one 66 ms outlier) | 0.8% (1.6%) | stroke shown, all 3 |
22	| frame (Choreographer frame callback) | 1 | 0.20 / 0.28 / 0.49 | 7.8 / 8.2 | 0.4% | stroke shown, all 3 |
23	| immediate (inside `onStrokesFinished`) | 1 | 0.20 / 0.27 / 0.66 | 0.03 / 0.05 | 0.7% | stroke shown, all 3 |
24	Front buffer works on HyperOS: InProgressStrokesView adds a SurfaceView (BLAST, z=1) above the window on the first stroke. Requesting the 144 Hz mode left the display at 120 Hz (device.md#display). Screenshots settle >= 100 ms after pen-up, so single-frame flicker and felt latency are a USER-CHECK. Motion prediction was not wired in the spike (P03).
25	Decision 2026-09-27: A confirmed (p95 0.29 ms vs 1 ms budget, handoff clean). Handoff mode: commit, the only mode that removes wet strokes after the frame showing the committed stroke by construction (A-005).
26	
27	## ADR-003 Committed content rendering
28	Status: Proposed (decided by P01-S2)
29	Context: Dense pages (1500+ strokes, text, images) must pan/zoom at 144 Hz.
30	Options: A software bitmap tiles (512 px) rendered off the main thread; B RenderNode tiles with compositing layers (GPU-cached display lists); C draw all objects every frame.
31	Decision (default): A, because the same code path serves PNG export and it is portable; B if it wins the spike clearly on jank. C rejected (cost grows with content).
32	Consequences: memory budget and tile invalidation logic required; zoom shows scaled tiles briefly until the new bucket renders.
33	
34	## ADR-004 Library storage

## ADR-002 Ink stack
Status: Accepted (2026-09-27, P01-S1)
Context: Wet ink must be as low-latency as possible (R-INK-08); strokes need pressure/tilt brushes, geometry for erasing and lasso, and stable rendering.
Options: A androidx.ink 1.1.0-alpha (newest alpha; public brush customization API, fixes since 1.0.0); B androidx.ink 1.0.0 stable (Dec 2025); C custom renderer on androidx.graphics front-buffered surfaces.
Decision: A, pinned to an exact alpha. Front-buffered wet ink via `InProgressStrokesView`, finished strokes via `CanvasStrokeRenderer`, geometry for erase/lasso. The experimental mesh-editing partial eraser (1.1.0-alpha05+) is not used because its results are not yet serializable; Folio splits stroke inputs instead (06-ink-input.md#erasers). Our file format stores our own `StrokeInputs`, not ink's serialization, so a library change never breaks files.
Fallback: B if an alpha regresses on the device; C only if the spike proves ink unusable on HyperOS.
Revisit: when ink 1.1.0 goes stable (move to stable).
Evidence 2026-09-27 (P01-S1): Pad 7, debug build, ink 1.1.0-alpha09, route `spike-ink` (pressure pen, CanvasStrokeRenderer page, DisplayModeHelper), 50 synthetic `input stylus swipe` strokes per run (400 ms, 50 events each). Median of runs, worst in brackets.
| Handoff mode | Runs | `ink:onTouch` p50 / p95 / max ms | `ink:handoff` p50 / p95 ms | Janky frames | 3 screenshots after pen-up |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| commit (ViewTreeObserver frame-commit callback) | 3 | 0.20 / 0.28 (0.29) / 0.55 (0.63) | 6.4 / 8.8 (one 66 ms outlier) | 0.8% (1.6%) | stroke shown, all 3 |
| frame (Choreographer frame callback) | 1 | 0.20 / 0.28 / 0.49 | 7.8 / 8.2 | 0.4% | stroke shown, all 3 |
| immediate (inside `onStrokesFinished`) | 1 | 0.20 / 0.27 / 0.66 | 0.03 / 0.05 | 0.7% | stroke shown, all 3 |
Front buffer works on HyperOS: InProgressStrokesView adds a SurfaceView (BLAST, z=1) above the window on the first stroke. Requesting the 144 Hz mode left the display at 120 Hz (device.md#display). Screenshots settle >= 100 ms after pen-up, so single-frame flicker and felt latency are a USER-CHECK. Motion prediction was not wired in the spike (P03).
Decision 2026-09-27: A confirmed (p95 0.29 ms vs 1 ms budget, handoff clean). Handoff mode: commit, the only mode that removes wet strokes after the frame showing the committed stroke by construction (A-005).

## ADR-003 Committed content rendering
Status: Proposed (decided by P01-S2)
Context: Dense pages (1500+ strokes, text, images) must pan/zoom at 144 Hz.
Options: A software bitmap tiles (512 px) rendered off the main thread; B RenderNode tiles with compositing layers (GPU-cached display lists); C draw all objects every frame.
Decision (default): A, because the same code path serves PNG export and it is portable; B if it wins the spike clearly on jank. C rejected (cost grows with content).
Consequences: memory budget and tile invalidation logic required; zoom shows scaled tiles briefly until the new bucket renders.

## ADR-004 Library storage

36	## Tiles
37	- Tile = 512x512 px at a zoom bucket. Key = (pageId, bucketIndex, tx, ty). Two caches: background and content.
38	- Rendering on the `render` dispatcher (2 threads). A tile render calls `PageRenderer.draw(canvas, page, tileRectPt, bucketScale, SCREEN)` with only objects returned by the spatial index for the tile rect.
39	- Strategy (ADR-003, decided by spike P01-S2): A = software ARGB_8888 bitmaps from `BitmapPool`; B = RenderNode per tile with compositing layer. The layer views draw tiles with a matrix derived from the Viewport, so pan/zoom never re-renders during a gesture.
40	- After gesture idle (100 ms): request tiles for the new bucket, visible first, center-out, keeping old-bucket tiles on screen until replacements are ready (no blank frames). Prefetch one tile ring around the viewport.
41	- Invalidation: a command produces changed bounds per page -> tiles intersecting those bounds (all buckets) are marked stale; visible stale tiles re-render immediately, others lazily. New strokes on top of the z-order can be painted incrementally onto existing content tiles instead of a full tile re-render.
42	- Memory: content + background caches <= 25% of `largeMemoryClass`; LRU eviction by bytes, visible tiles pinned. `onTrimMemory` drops non-visible tiles.
43	
44	## Page renderer
45	`PageRenderer.draw(canvas, page, regionPt, scale, target)` where target is SCREEN, EXPORT_RASTER, or EXPORT_VECTOR.
46	- Order: paper (not for SCREEN content layer), template (background layer only on SCREEN), PDF page (background layer or export path), objects in z-order.
47	- Ink: SCREEN/RASTER use `CanvasStrokeRenderer` (androidx.ink). VECTOR draws filled outline Paths built from the stroke mesh outlines (PDF canvases do not support mesh drawing).
48	- Text: cached block layouts painted per frame (07-text-engine.md#rendering); VECTOR keeps real text (fonts embedded by PdfDocument).
49	- Images: downsampled decode for SCREEN (sized to bucket), full resolution for export.
50	- Highlighter: drawn like other strokes with its alpha; no multiply blend (keeps output identical across targets).
51	- Deterministic: the same inputs produce the same pixels across targets (goldens rely on it).
52	
53	## Dry handoff
54	1. `InProgressStrokesView.onStrokesFinished(strokes)` delivers finished strokes (main thread).
55	2. The session executes `AddObjects` (converted `InkStroke`s). The content layer paints those strokes into the affected visible tiles synchronously on the render thread (incremental paint) and invalidates the layer.
56	3. A `ViewTreeObserver.registerFrameCommitCallback` registered right after that invalidate fires once the frame drawing the stroke is submitted; then `removeFinishedStrokes(ids)`. (A `Choreographer` frame callback runs before that frame's draw pass, which is too early; A-005.)
57	4. If tile paint fails or is pending (tile not yet rendered), the wet stroke stays until the tile containing it is drawn.
58	Result: never a frame without the stroke, never a double-dark overlap longer than one frame.

## Tiles
- Tile = 512x512 px at a zoom bucket. Key = (pageId, bucketIndex, tx, ty). Two caches: background and content.
- Rendering on the `render` dispatcher (2 threads). A tile render calls `PageRenderer.draw(canvas, page, tileRectPt, bucketScale, SCREEN)` with only objects returned by the spatial index for the tile rect.
- Strategy (ADR-003, decided by spike P01-S2): A = software ARGB_8888 bitmaps from `BitmapPool`; B = RenderNode per tile with compositing layer. The layer views draw tiles with a matrix derived from the Viewport, so pan/zoom never re-renders during a gesture.
- After gesture idle (100 ms): request tiles for the new bucket, visible first, center-out, keeping old-bucket tiles on screen until replacements are ready (no blank frames). Prefetch one tile ring around the viewport.
- Invalidation: a command produces changed bounds per page -> tiles intersecting those bounds (all buckets) are marked stale; visible stale tiles re-render immediately, others lazily. New strokes on top of the z-order can be painted incrementally onto existing content tiles instead of a full tile re-render.
- Memory: content + background caches <= 25% of `largeMemoryClass`; LRU eviction by bytes, visible tiles pinned. `onTrimMemory` drops non-visible tiles.

## Page renderer
`PageRenderer.draw(canvas, page, regionPt, scale, target)` where target is SCREEN, EXPORT_RASTER, or EXPORT_VECTOR.
- Order: paper (not for SCREEN content layer), template (background layer only on SCREEN), PDF page (background layer or export path), objects in z-order.
- Ink: SCREEN/RASTER use `CanvasStrokeRenderer` (androidx.ink). VECTOR draws filled outline Paths built from the stroke mesh outlines (PDF canvases do not support mesh drawing).
- Text: cached block layouts painted per frame (07-text-engine.md#rendering); VECTOR keeps real text (fonts embedded by PdfDocument).
- Images: downsampled decode for SCREEN (sized to bucket), full resolution for export.
- Highlighter: drawn like other strokes with its alpha; no multiply blend (keeps output identical across targets).
- Deterministic: the same inputs produce the same pixels across targets (goldens rely on it).

## Dry handoff
1. `InProgressStrokesView.onStrokesFinished(strokes)` delivers finished strokes (main thread).
2. The session executes `AddObjects` (converted `InkStroke`s). The content layer paints those strokes into the affected visible tiles synchronously on the render thread (incremental paint) and invalidates the layer.
3. A `ViewTreeObserver.registerFrameCommitCallback` registered right after that invalidate fires once the frame drawing the stroke is submitted; then `removeFinishedStrokes(ids)`. (A `Choreographer` frame callback runs before that frame's draw pass, which is too early; A-005.)
4. If tile paint fails or is pending (tile not yet rendered), the wet stroke stays until the tile containing it is drawn.
Result: never a frame without the stroke, never a double-dark overlap longer than one frame.

12	import android.view.PixelCopy

14	import androidx.annotation.MainThread
15	import androidx.annotation.WorkerThread
16	import dev.folio.core.common.FolioDispatchers
17	import dev.folio.core.common.PerfMonitor
18	import dev.folio.core.render.DisplayModeHelper
19	import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope
20	import kotlinx.coroutines.SupervisorJob
21	import kotlinx.coroutines.cancel
22	import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
23	import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext

25	import kotlinx.serialization.json.buildJsonObject

30	/**
31	 * Spike P01-S2: an A4 lined page with 1500 seeded strokes shown through 512 px tiles, either
32	 * software bitmaps (A) or RenderNodes with compositing layers (B). Finger drag pans; zoom is
33	 * scripted (`debugcmd.sh zoom-anim`). During gestures tiles are only transformed; 100 ms after
34	 * the gesture the current zoom bucket renders center-out (05-canvas-rendering.md#tiles).
35	 * Deleted or promoted by P01-T08.
36	 */
37	@SuppressLint("ViewConstructor") // created in code by AppDebugHooks only
38	@Suppress("TooManyFunctions") // spike screen: viewport, input, scripted zoom and verify in one place until P01-T08
39	@MainThread
40	internal class SpikeTilesView(
41	    private val activity: Activity,
42	    private val dispatchers: FolioDispatchers,
43	) : View(activity) {
44	    private val scope = CoroutineScope(SupervisorJob() + dispatchers.main)
45	    private val cache = SpikeTileCache(dispatchers, scope, ::onTileReady)
46	    private val displayModes = DisplayModeHelper(activity.window)
47	    private val pagePaint = Paint().apply { color = PAPER_ARGB }
48	    private val idle = Runnable { onGestureIdle() }
49	    private val zoomFrame = Choreographer.FrameCallback(::onZoomFrame)
50	    private val sidePaddingPx = SIDE_PADDING_DP * resources.displayMetrics.density
51	    private val topPaddingPx = TOP_PADDING_DP * resources.displayMetrics.density
52	    private var lastX = 0f
53	    private var lastY = 0f
54	    private var lastRequestMs = 0L
55	    private var settleStartNs = 0L
56	    private var verifyPending = false
57	    private var animFrom = 1f
58	    private var animTo = 1f
59	    private var animStartNs = 0L
60	    private var animDurationNs = 0L
61	
62	    /** Zoom as a multiple of fit-width. */
63	    var zoom = 1f
64	        private set
65	
66	    /** Current px per pt; 0 until laid out. */
67	    var scale = 0f
68	        private set
69	    var offsetXPx = 0f
70	        private set
71	    var offsetYPx = 0f
72	        private set
73	
74	    /** Zoom bucket tiles are rendered at; follows [scale] 100 ms after a gesture. */
75	    var bucket = 0
76	        private set
77	    var seedMs: Double? = null
78	        private set
79	    var strokeCount = 0
80	        private set
81	    var requestedHz: Float? = null
82	        private set
83	    var lastVerify: JsonObject? = null
84	        private set
85	    val strategy: TileStrategy get() = cache.strategy
86	    val tileCount: Int get() = cache.tileCount
87	    val pendingCount: Int get() = cache.pendingCount
88	    val pooledCount: Int get() = cache.pooledCount
89	
90	    override fun onAttachedToWindow() {
91	        super.onAttachedToWindow()
92	        requestedHz = display?.let(displayModes::request)
93	        scope.launch {
94	            val startNs = SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos()
95	            val page =
96	                withContext(dispatchers.render) {
97	                    PerfMonitor.trace(SECTION_SEED) {
98	                        SpikePage.create(SyntheticStrokes.generate(SpikePage.WIDTH_PT, SpikePage.HEIGHT_PT))
99	                    }
100	                }
101	            seedMs = (SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos() - startNs) / NS_PER_MS
102	            strokeCount = page.strokeCount
103	            cache.renderer = SpikeTileRenderer(page)
104	            settleStartNs = SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos()
105	            requestVisible()
106	        }
107	    }
108	
109	    override fun onDetachedFromWindow() {
110	        Choreographer.getInstance().removeFrameCallback(zoomFrame)
111	        removeCallbacks(idle)
112	        scope.cancel()
113	        cache.reset()
114	        displayModes.release()
115	        super.onDetachedFromWindow()
116	    }
117	
118	    override fun onSizeChanged(
119	        w: Int,
120	        h: Int,
121	        oldw: Int,
122	        oldh: Int,
123	    ) {
124	        if (scale == 0f) {
125	            scale = fitScale() * zoom
126	            offsetYPx = topPaddingPx
127	            clamp()
128	            bucket = TileMath.bucketIndex(scale)
129	        }
130	        requestVisible()
131	    }
132	
133	    /** Drops all tiles and renders the visible ones again with [next]. */
134	    fun switchStrategy(next: TileStrategy) {
135	        cache.reset(next)
136	        settleStartNs = SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos()
137	        requestVisible()
138	        invalidate()
139	    }
140	
141	    /** Jumps to [target] zoom around the view center and re-renders at once. */
142	    fun jumpToZoom(target: Float) {
143	        Choreographer.getInstance().removeFrameCallback(zoomFrame)
144	        applyZoom(target)
145	        onGestureIdle()
146	    }
147	
148	    /** Animates zoom [from] -> [to] around the view center over [durationMs] (smoothstep), one step per frame. */
149	    fun animateZoom(
150	        from: Float,
151	        to: Float,
152	        durationMs: Long,
153	    ) {
154	        removeCallbacks(idle)
155	        applyZoom(from)
156	        animFrom = from
157	        animTo = to
158	        animStartNs = 0L
159	        animDurationNs = durationMs * NS_PER_MS.toLong()
160	        Choreographer.getInstance().removeFrameCallback(zoomFrame)
161	        Choreographer.getInstance().postFrameCallback(zoomFrame)
162	    }
163	
164	    /**
165	     * Snaps the scale to its bucket (1:1 tile pixels) and integer offsets, waits for the visible
166	     * tiles, then compares the window pixels with a direct render of the page ([lastVerify]).
167	     */
168	    fun verify() {
169	        applyZoom(TileMath.bucketScale(TileMath.bucketIndex(scale)) / fitScale())
170	        offsetXPx = offsetXPx.roundToInt().toFloat()
171	        offsetYPx = offsetYPx.roundToInt().toFloat()
172	        verifyPending = true
173	        lastVerify = buildJsonObject { put("state", "pending") }
174	        onGestureIdle()
175	        invalidate()
176	    }
177	
178	    override fun onDraw(canvas: Canvas) =
179	        PerfMonitor.trace(SECTION_DRAW) {
180	            // HOT PATH: every frame during pan and zoom; no allocation.
181	            canvas.drawColor(SURROUND_ARGB)
182	            if (scale == 0f) return@trace
183	            val right = offsetXPx + SpikePage.WIDTH_PT * scale
184	            val bottom = offsetYPx + SpikePage.HEIGHT_PT * scale
185	            canvas.drawRect(offsetXPx, offsetYPx, right, bottom, pagePaint)
186	            cache.draw(canvas, bucket, scale, offsetXPx, offsetYPx)
187	        }
188	
189	    @SuppressLint("ClickableViewAccessibility") // spike: one-finger pan only, no click action
190	    override fun onTouchEvent(event: MotionEvent): Boolean {
191	        // HOT PATH: per MotionEvent; no allocation.
192	        when (event.actionMasked) {
193	            MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN -> {
194	                lastX = event.x
195	                lastY = event.y
196	                removeCallbacks(idle)
197	            }
198	
199	            MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE -> {
200	                offsetXPx += event.x - lastX
201	                offsetYPx += event.y - lastY
202	                lastX = event.x
203	                lastY = event.y
204	                clamp()
205	                invalidate()
206	                val nowMs = SystemClock.uptimeMillis()
207	                if (nowMs - lastRequestMs >= PAN_REQUEST_INTERVAL_MS) {
208	                    lastRequestMs = nowMs
209	                    requestVisible() // same bucket while panning: render newly exposed tiles right away
210	                }
211	            }
212	
213	            MotionEvent.ACTION_UP, MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL -> {
214	                postDelayed(idle, IDLE_MS)
215	            }
216	        }
217	        return true
218	    }
219	
220	    private fun onZoomFrame(frameTimeNanos: Long) {
221	        if (animStartNs == 0L) animStartNs = frameTimeNanos
222	        val t = min(1f, (frameTimeNanos - animStartNs).toFloat() / animDurationNs)
223	        val eased = t * t * (3f - 2f * t)
224	        applyZoom(animFrom + (animTo - animFrom) * eased)
225	        if (t < 1f) Choreographer.getInstance().postFrameCallback(zoomFrame) else postDelayed(idle, IDLE_MS)
226	    }
227	
228	    private fun fitScale(): Float = (width - 2 * sidePaddingPx) / SpikePage.WIDTH_PT
229	
230	    /** Sets [target] zoom keeping the page point under the view center fixed (focal-point zoom). */
231	    private fun applyZoom(target: Float) {
232	        if (width == 0) return
233	        val next = fitScale() * target.coerceIn(MIN_ZOOM, MAX_ZOOM)
234	        val focusX = width / 2f
235	        val focusY = height / 2f
236	        val pageX = (focusX - offsetXPx) / scale
237	        val pageY = (focusY - offsetYPx) / scale
238	        zoom = target.coerceIn(MIN_ZOOM, MAX_ZOOM)
239	        scale = next
240	        offsetXPx = focusX - pageX * next
241	        offsetYPx = focusY - pageY * next
242	        clamp()
243	        invalidate()
244	    }
245	
246	    /** Centers a page narrower than the view; otherwise allows half a screen of overscroll. */
247	    private fun clamp() {
248	        val contentW = SpikePage.WIDTH_PT * scale
249	        val contentH = SpikePage.HEIGHT_PT * scale
250	        offsetXPx =
251	            if (contentW <= width) (width - contentW) / 2f else offsetXPx.coerceIn(width / 2f - contentW, width / 2f)
252	        offsetYPx = offsetYPx.coerceIn(height / 2f - contentH, height / 2f)
253	    }
254	
255	    private fun onGestureIdle() {
256	        val next = TileMath.bucketIndex(scale)
257	        if (next != bucket) {
258	            bucket = next
259	            settleStartNs = SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos()
260	        }
261	        requestVisible()
262	        onTileReady()
263	    }
264	
265	    private fun visibleRange(ring: Int): TileRange =
266	        TileMath.visibleTiles(
267	            SpikePage.WIDTH_PT,
268	            SpikePage.HEIGHT_PT,
269	            scale,
270	            offsetXPx,
271	            offsetYPx,
272	            width,
273	            height,
274	            TileMath.bucketScale(bucket),
275	            ring,
276	        )
277	
278	    private fun requestVisible() {
279	        if (width == 0 || scale == 0f) return
280	        val toBucket = TileMath.bucketScale(bucket) / scale
281	        val order = TileMath.centerOut(visibleRange(ring = 1), (width / 2f - offsetXPx) * toBucket, (height / 2f - offsetYPx) * toBucket)
282	        cache.request(bucket, order)
283	    }
284	
285	    /** After a tile arrives: record settle time, evict replaced tiles, run a pending verify. */
286	    private fun onTileReady() {
287	        invalidate()
288	        if (scale == 0f || !cache.complete(bucket, visibleRange(ring = 0))) return
289	        if (settleStartNs != 0L) {
290	            PerfMonitor.record("tiles:settle${strategy.name}", SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos() - settleStartNs)
291	            settleStartNs = 0L
292	        }
293	        cache.evict(bucket, visibleRange(ring = 2))
294	        if (verifyPending) {
295	            verifyPending = false
296	            viewTreeObserver.registerFrameCommitCallback(::capture) // after the frame showing every tile
297	        }
298	    }
299	
300	    private fun capture() {
301	        val renderer = cache.renderer ?: return
302	        val location = IntArray(2).also(::getLocationInWindow)
303	        val shot = Bitmap.createBitmap(width, height, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888)
304	        val source = Rect(location[0], location[1], location[0] + width, location[1] + height)
305	        val snapshot = ViewSnapshot(strategy, scale, offsetXPx, offsetYPx)
306	        PixelCopy.request(activity.window, source, shot, { result ->
307	            if (result != PixelCopy.SUCCESS) {
308	                lastVerify = buildJsonObject { put("error", "PixelCopy result $result") }
309	                return@request
310	            }
311	            scope.launch { lastVerify = withContext(dispatchers.render) { compare(shot, renderer, snapshot) } }
312	        }, handler)
313	    }
314	
315	    @WorkerThread
316	    private fun compare(
317	        shot: Bitmap,
318	        renderer: SpikeTileRenderer,
319	        at: ViewSnapshot,
320	    ): JsonObject {
321	        val reference = Bitmap.createBitmap(shot.width, shot.height, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888)
322	        val canvas = Canvas(reference)
323	        canvas.drawColor(SURROUND_ARGB)
324	        val paper = Paint().apply { color = PAPER_ARGB }
325	        canvas.drawRect(
326	            at.offsetXPx,
327	            at.offsetYPx,
328	            at.offsetXPx + SpikePage.WIDTH_PT * at.scale,
329	            at.offsetYPx + SpikePage.HEIGHT_PT * at.scale,
330	            paper,
331	        )
332	        renderer.renderReference(canvas, at.scale, at.offsetXPx, at.offsetYPx)
333	        val diff = PixelDiff().addBitmaps(shot, reference)
334	        reference.recycle()
335	        shot.recycle()
336	        return buildJsonObject {
337	            put("strategy", at.strategy.name)
338	            put("scale", at.scale)
339	            put("pixels", diff.pixels)
340	            put("differingPct", diff.differingPct)
341	            put("meanChannelDiff", diff.meanChannelDiff)
342	        }
343	    }
344	
345	    private class ViewSnapshot(
346	        val strategy: TileStrategy,
347	        val scale: Float,
348	        val offsetXPx: Float,
349	        val offsetYPx: Float,
350	    )
351	
352	    companion object {
353	        const val ROUTE = "spike-tiles"
354	        const val SECTION_SEED = "tiles:seed"
355	        const val SECTION_DRAW = "tiles:draw"
356	        const val MIN_ZOOM = 0.25f
357	        const val MAX_ZOOM = 8f
358	        private const val IDLE_MS = 100L
359	        private const val PAN_REQUEST_INTERVAL_MS = 50L
360	        private const val SIDE_PADDING_DP = 24f
361	        private const val TOP_PADDING_DP = 16f
362	        private const val NS_PER_MS = 1_000_000.0
363	        private const val SURROUND_ARGB = 0xFFE9ECF1.toInt()
364	        private const val PAPER_ARGB = 0xFFFFFFFF.toInt()
365	    }
366	}

1	package dev.folio.app.spikes

3	import dev.folio.app.debug.DebugReply
4	import kotlinx.serialization.json.buildJsonObject
5	import kotlinx.serialization.json.put
6	
7	/** Parsed `zoom-anim from,to,durationMs` argument. */
8	internal data class ZoomAnim(
9	    val from: Float,
10	    val to: Float,
11	    val durationMs: Long,
12	) {
13	    companion object {
14	        private const val PARTS = 3
15	        private const val MAX_DURATION_MS = 10_000L
16	
17	        /** Null unless [arg] is three comma-separated numbers with zooms in range and 1..10000 ms. */
18	        fun parse(arg: String?): ZoomAnim? {
19	            val parts = arg?.split(',')?.takeIf { it.size == PARTS } ?: return null
20	            val zoomRange = SpikeTilesView.MIN_ZOOM..SpikeTilesView.MAX_ZOOM
21	            val from = parts[0].toFloatOrNull()?.takeIf { it in zoomRange }
22	            val to = parts[1].toFloatOrNull()?.takeIf { it in zoomRange }
23	            val durationMs = parts[2].toLongOrNull()?.takeIf { it in 1..MAX_DURATION_MS }
24	            return if (from != null && to != null && durationMs != null) ZoomAnim(from, to, durationMs) else null
25	        }
26	    }
27	}
28	
29	/**
30	 * `debugcmd.sh spike-tiles [stats|a|b|zoom=<z>|verify]` for P01-S2: reports viewport and cache
31	 * counters (and the last verify result), switches the tile strategy, jumps to a zoom, or starts a
32	 * pixel comparison against a direct render. [view] is null while the route is hidden.
33	 */
34	internal fun spikeTilesCommand(
35	    view: SpikeTilesView?,
36	    arg: String?,
37	): DebugReply {

39	    val zoom = arg?.removePrefix("zoom=")?.takeIf { arg.startsWith("zoom=") }
40	    when {
41	        arg == null || arg == "stats" -> Unit
42	        arg == "verify" -> view.verify()
43	        zoom != null -> view.jumpToZoom(zoom.toFloatOrNull() ?: return DebugReply.error("zoom needs a number"))
44	        else -> view.switchStrategy(TileStrategy.parse(arg) ?: return DebugReply.error("spike-tiles needs stats|a|b|zoom=<z>|verify"))

1	package dev.folio.app.spikes
2	
3	import android.graphics.Bitmap
4	import android.graphics.Canvas
5	import android.graphics.Paint
6	import androidx.annotation.MainThread
7	import dev.folio.core.common.FolioDispatchers
8	import kotlinx.coroutines.CancellationException
9	import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope
10	import kotlinx.coroutines.Job
11	import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
12	import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
13	
14	/**
15	 * Tile cache of the P01-S2 spike: renders missing tiles on the render dispatcher (center-out),
16	 * keeps other-bucket tiles on screen until the current bucket is complete, pools bitmaps (A).
17	 * Main thread only; [onTileReady] fires after each accepted tile.
18	 */
19	@MainThread
20	internal class SpikeTileCache(
21	    private val dispatchers: FolioDispatchers,
22	    private val scope: CoroutineScope,
23	    private val onTileReady: () -> Unit,
24	) {
25	    private val tiles = ArrayList<SpikeTile>()
26	    private val inFlight = HashMap<Long, Job>()
27	    private val pool = ArrayDeque<Bitmap>()
28	    private val bitmapPaint = Paint(Paint.FILTER_BITMAP_FLAG)
29	    private var generation = 0
30	
31	    var renderer: SpikeTileRenderer? = null
32	    var strategy = TileStrategy.A
33	        private set
34	
35	    val tileCount: Int get() = tiles.size
36	    val pendingCount: Int get() = inFlight.size
37	    val pooledCount: Int get() = pool.size
38	
39	    /** Drops every tile and in-flight render, then switches to [next]. */
40	    fun reset(next: TileStrategy = strategy) {
41	        generation++
42	        inFlight.values.forEach { it.cancel() }
43	        inFlight.clear()
44	        tiles.forEach(::recycle)
45	        tiles.clear()
46	        strategy = next
47	    }
48	
49	    /** Starts renders for the [order]ed tiles of [bucket] that are neither cached nor in flight. */
50	    fun request(
51	        bucket: Int,
52	        order: List<Pair<Int, Int>>,
53	    ) {
54	        val renderer = renderer ?: return
55	        val stale = inFlight.entries.iterator()
56	        while (stale.hasNext()) {
57	            val (key, job) = stale.next()
58	            if (tileBucket(key) == bucket) continue
59	            job.cancel() // an old bucket nobody waits for; its bitmap returns to the pool
60	            stale.remove()
61	        }
62	        val section = "tiles:render${strategy.name}:b$bucket"
63	        for ((tx, ty) in order) {
64	            val key = tileKey(bucket, tx, ty)
65	            if (key in inFlight || tiles.any { it.key == key }) continue
66	            inFlight[key] = launch(renderer, bucket, tx, ty, section)
67	        }
68	    }
69	
70	    /** True when every tile of [range] at [bucket] is cached. */
71	    fun complete(
72	        bucket: Int,
73	        range: TileRange,
74	    ): Boolean {
75	        if (range.isEmpty) return true
76	        var have = 0
77	        for (tile in tiles) if (tile.bucket == bucket && range.contains(tile.tx, tile.ty)) have++
78	        return have == (range.txMax - range.txMin + 1) * (range.tyMax - range.tyMin + 1)
79	    }
80	
81	    /** Drops tiles of other buckets and current-bucket tiles outside [keep]. */
82	    fun evict(
83	        bucket: Int,
84	        keep: TileRange,
85	    ) {
86	        tiles.removeAll { tile -> (tile.bucket != bucket || !keep.contains(tile.tx, tile.ty)).also { if (it) recycle(tile) } }
87	    }
88	
89	    /** Draws cached tiles for a view at [scale] with the page origin at ([offsetXPx], [offsetYPx]); current bucket on top. */
90	    fun draw(
91	        canvas: Canvas,
92	        bucket: Int,
93	        scale: Float,
94	        offsetXPx: Float,
95	        offsetYPx: Float,
96	    ) {
97	        // HOT PATH: runs every frame during pan and zoom; no allocation.
98	        for (pass in 0..1) {
99	            for (i in tiles.indices) {
100	                val tile = tiles[i]
101	                if ((tile.bucket == bucket) == (pass == 0)) continue
102	                drawTile(canvas, tile, scale, offsetXPx, offsetYPx)
103	            }
104	        }
105	    }
106	
107	    private fun drawTile(
108	        canvas: Canvas,
109	        tile: SpikeTile,
110	        scale: Float,
111	        offsetXPx: Float,
112	        offsetYPx: Float,
113	    ) {
114	        val k = scale / tile.bucketScale
115	        val sizePx = TileMath.TILE_PX * k
116	        val left = offsetXPx + tile.tx * sizePx
117	        val top = offsetYPx + tile.ty * sizePx
118	        if (left > canvas.width || top > canvas.height || left + sizePx < 0f || top + sizePx < 0f) return
119	        canvas.save()
120	        canvas.translate(left, top)
121	        canvas.scale(k, k)
122	        tile.bitmap?.let { canvas.drawBitmap(it, 0f, 0f, bitmapPaint) }
123	        tile.node?.let { if (canvas.isHardwareAccelerated) canvas.drawRenderNode(it) }
124	        canvas.restore()
125	    }
126	
127	    private fun launch(
128	        renderer: SpikeTileRenderer,
129	        bucket: Int,
130	        tx: Int,
131	        ty: Int,
132	        section: String,
133	    ): Job {
134	        val gen = generation
135	        val mode = strategy
136	        val bitmap = if (mode == TileStrategy.A) pool.removeLastOrNull() ?: newBitmap() else null
137	        return scope.launch {
138	            val tile =
139	                try {
140	                    withContext(dispatchers.render) { renderer.render(mode, bucket, tx, ty, bitmap, section) }
141	                } catch (e: CancellationException) {
142	                    bitmap?.let(::release) // withContext returns only after the render finished
143	                    throw e
144	                }
145	            if (gen != generation) {
146	                recycle(tile)
147	                return@launch
148	            }
149	            inFlight.remove(tile.key)
150	            tiles += tile
151	            onTileReady()
152	        }
153	    }
154	
155	    private fun newBitmap(): Bitmap = Bitmap.createBitmap(TileMath.TILE_PX, TileMath.TILE_PX, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888)
156	
157	    private fun recycle(tile: SpikeTile) {
158	        tile.bitmap?.let(::release)
159	        tile.node?.discardDisplayList()
160	    }
161	
162	    private fun release(bitmap: Bitmap) {
163	        if (pool.size < POOL_MAX) pool.addLast(bitmap) else bitmap.recycle()
164	    }
165	
166	    private companion object {
167	        const val POOL_MAX = 24
168	    }
169	}

1	package dev.folio.app.spikes
2	
3	import android.graphics.Bitmap
4	import android.graphics.Canvas
5	import android.graphics.RenderNode
6	import androidx.annotation.WorkerThread
7	import dev.folio.core.common.PerfMonitor
8	
9	/** Committed-content strategies compared by P01-S2 (decisions.md#adr-003-committed-content-rendering). */
10	internal enum class TileStrategy {
11	    /** Software ARGB_8888 bitmap per tile. */
12	    A,
13	
14	    /** RenderNode per tile with a compositing layer (GPU-cached display list). */
15	    B,
16	    ;
17	
18	    companion object {
19	        fun parse(name: String): TileStrategy? = entries.firstOrNull { it.name.equals(name, ignoreCase = true) }
20	    }
21	}
22	
23	/** One rendered 512 px tile; exactly one of [bitmap] (A) and [node] (B) is set. */
24	internal class SpikeTile(
25	    val bucket: Int,
26	    val tx: Int,
27	    val ty: Int,
28	    val bitmap: Bitmap?,
29	    val node: RenderNode?,
30	) {
31	    val bucketScale: Float = TileMath.bucketScale(bucket)
32	    val key: Long get() = tileKey(bucket, tx, ty)
33	}
34	
35	/** Packs a tile address into one Long; bucket and indices must lie in 0 until 2^21. */
36	internal fun tileKey(
37	    bucket: Int,
38	    tx: Int,
39	    ty: Int,
40	): Long = ((bucket.toLong() and MASK) shl SHIFT_BUCKET) or ((tx.toLong() and MASK) shl SHIFT_TX) or (ty.toLong() and MASK)
41	
42	/** Bucket of a key made by [tileKey]. */
43	internal fun tileBucket(key: Long): Int = ((key ushr SHIFT_BUCKET) and MASK).toInt()
44	
45	private const val MASK = 0x1FFFFFL
46	private const val SHIFT_BUCKET = 42
47	private const val SHIFT_TX = 21
48	
49	/** Renders tiles of a [SpikePage] with either strategy; safe to call from several render threads. */
50	internal class SpikeTileRenderer(
51	    private val page: SpikePage,
52	) {
53	    private val painters = ThreadLocal.withInitial { SpikePage.Painter() }
54	
55	    /** Renders tile ([tx], [ty]) at [bucket] into [bitmap] (A, reused from the pool) or a new RenderNode (B). */
56	    @WorkerThread
57	    fun render(
58	        strategy: TileStrategy,
59	        bucket: Int,
60	        tx: Int,
61	        ty: Int,
62	        bitmap: Bitmap?,
63	        section: String,
64	    ): SpikeTile =
65	        PerfMonitor.trace(section) {
66	            val scale = TileMath.bucketScale(bucket)
67	            val painter = painters.get() ?: SpikePage.Painter()
68	            val px = TileMath.TILE_PX.toFloat()
69	            val toDevice =
70	                painter.matrix.apply {
71	                    setScale(scale, scale)
72	                    postTranslate(-tx * px, -ty * px)
73	                }
74	            val leftPt = tx * px / scale
75	            val topPt = ty * px / scale
76	            val sizePt = px / scale
77	            when (strategy) {
78	                TileStrategy.A -> {
79	                    val target = checkNotNull(bitmap) { "strategy A needs a pooled bitmap" }
80	                    target.eraseColor(0)
81	                    val canvas = Canvas(target)
82	                    canvas.concat(toDevice)
83	                    page.draw(canvas, painter, leftPt, topPt, leftPt + sizePt, topPt + sizePt, toDevice)
84	                    SpikeTile(bucket, tx, ty, target, null)
85	                }
86	
87	                TileStrategy.B -> {
88	                    val node = RenderNode("tile")
89	                    node.setPosition(0, 0, TileMath.TILE_PX, TileMath.TILE_PX)
90	                    node.setUseCompositingLayer(true, null)
91	                    val canvas = node.beginRecording(TileMath.TILE_PX, TileMath.TILE_PX)
92	                    try {
93	                        canvas.concat(toDevice)
94	                        page.draw(canvas, painter, leftPt, topPt, leftPt + sizePt, topPt + sizePt, toDevice)
95	                    } finally {
96	                        node.endRecording()
97	                    }
98	                    SpikeTile(bucket, tx, ty, null, node)
99	                }
100	            }
101	        }
102	
103	    /** Draws the page directly (no tiles) as seen by a view at [scale] and offset: the verify reference. */
104	    @WorkerThread
105	    fun renderReference(
106	        canvas: Canvas,
107	        scale: Float,
108	        offsetXPx: Float,
109	        offsetYPx: Float,
110	    ) {
111	        val painter = painters.get() ?: SpikePage.Painter()
112	        val toDevice =
113	            painter.matrix.apply {
114	                setScale(scale, scale)
115	                postTranslate(offsetXPx, offsetYPx)
116	            }
117	        canvas.save()
118	        canvas.concat(toDevice)
119	        page.draw(
120	            canvas,
121	            painter,
122	            -offsetXPx / scale,
123	            -offsetYPx / scale,
124	            (canvas.width - offsetXPx) / scale,
125	            (canvas.height - offsetYPx) / scale,
126	            toDevice,
127	        )
128	        canvas.restore()
129	    }
130	}

2	
3	import android.graphics.Canvas
4	import android.graphics.Color
5	import android.graphics.Matrix
6	import android.graphics.Paint
7	import androidx.annotation.WorkerThread
8	import androidx.ink.brush.Brush
9	import androidx.ink.brush.InputToolType
10	import androidx.ink.brush.StockBrushes
11	import androidx.ink.rendering.android.canvas.CanvasStrokeRenderer
12	import androidx.ink.strokes.MutableStrokeInputBatch
13	import androidx.ink.strokes.Stroke
14	import kotlin.math.ceil
15	import kotlin.math.max
16	import kotlin.math.min
17	
18	/**
19	 * Committed content of the P01-S2 spike: an A4 college-ruled page with seeded ink strokes, drawn
20	 * for any page region. Stands in for `PageRenderer.draw` (05-canvas-rendering.md#page-renderer).
21	 */
22	internal class SpikePage private constructor(
23	    private val strokes: List<Stroke>,
24	    private val boundsPt: FloatArray, // left, top, right, bottom per stroke
25	) {
26	    val strokeCount: Int get() = strokes.size
27	
28	    /**
29	     * Draws paper, template and the strokes intersecting the region onto [canvas], whose matrix
30	     * already maps page points to device pixels; [toDevice] is that matrix, for the stroke renderer.
31	     * HOT PATH (render thread): no allocation.
32	     */
33	    @WorkerThread
34	    @Suppress("LongParameterList") // region edges as plain floats avoid a RectF per tile
35	    fun draw(
36	        canvas: Canvas,
37	        painter: Painter,
38	        leftPt: Float,
39	        topPt: Float,
40	        rightPt: Float,
41	        bottomPt: Float,
42	        toDevice: Matrix,
43	    ) {
44	        val l = max(leftPt, 0f)
45	        val t = max(topPt, 0f)
46	        val r = min(rightPt, WIDTH_PT)
47	        val b = min(bottomPt, HEIGHT_PT)
48	        if (l >= r || t >= b) return
49	        canvas.save()
50	        canvas.clipRect(l, t, r, b)
51	        canvas.drawRect(l, t, r, b, painter.paper)
52	        val first = ceil((t - RULE_TOP_PT) / RULE_SPACING_PT).toInt().coerceAtLeast(0)
53	        var y = RULE_TOP_PT + first * RULE_SPACING_PT
54	        while (y <= b) {
55	            canvas.drawLine(l, y, r, y, painter.rule)
56	            y += RULE_SPACING_PT
57	        }
58	        if (MARGIN_X_PT in l..r) canvas.drawLine(MARGIN_X_PT, t, MARGIN_X_PT, b, painter.margin)
59	        for (i in strokes.indices) {
60	            val o = i * 4
61	            if (boundsPt[o] > r || boundsPt[o + 2] < l || boundsPt[o + 1] > b || boundsPt[o + 3] < t) continue
62	            painter.renderer.draw(canvas, strokes[i], toDevice)
63	        }
64	        canvas.restore()
65	    }
66	
67	    /** Per-thread drawing state: the ink renderer caches per-stroke data and is not shared across threads. */
68	    class Painter {
69	        val renderer: CanvasStrokeRenderer = CanvasStrokeRenderer.create()
70	        val matrix = Matrix()
71	        val paper = Paint().apply { color = Color.WHITE }
72	        val rule =
73	            Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
74	                color = RULE_ARGB.toInt()
75	                strokeWidth = RULE_WIDTH_PT
76	            }
77	        val margin =
78	            Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
79	                color = MARGIN_ARGB.toInt()
80	                strokeWidth = RULE_WIDTH_PT
81	            }
82	    }
83	
84	    companion object {
85	        const val WIDTH_PT = 595.28f
86	        const val HEIGHT_PT = 841.89f
87	        private const val MM_PT = 72f / 25.4f
88	        private const val RULE_SPACING_PT = 7.1f * MM_PT // college ruling (05-canvas-rendering.md#templates)
89	        private const val RULE_TOP_PT = 25f * MM_PT
90	        private const val MARGIN_X_PT = 25f * MM_PT
91	        private const val RULE_WIDTH_PT = 0.5f
92	        private const val RULE_ARGB = 0xFFC9D3E0
93	        private const val MARGIN_ARGB = 0xFFF2A6A6
94	        private const val BRUSH_EPSILON_PT = 0.05f
95	        private const val SAMPLE_INTERVAL_MS = 5L
96	
97	        /** Builds ink strokes (meshes) for [synthetic]; takes a while for 1500 strokes. */
98	        @WorkerThread
99	        fun create(synthetic: List<SyntheticStroke>): SpikePage {
100	            val strokes = ArrayList<Stroke>(synthetic.size)
101	            val bounds = FloatArray(synthetic.size * 4)
102	            synthetic.forEachIndexed { i, s ->
103	                val stroke = s.toInk()
104	                val box = stroke.shape.computeBoundingBox()
105	                val o = i * 4
106	                if (box != null) {
107	                    bounds[o] = box.xMin
108	                    bounds[o + 1] = box.yMin
109	                    bounds[o + 2] = box.xMax
110	                    bounds[o + 3] = box.yMax
111	                }
112	                strokes += stroke
113	            }
114	            return SpikePage(strokes, bounds)
115	        }
116	
117	        private fun SyntheticStroke.toInk(): Stroke {
118	            val family =
119	                when (brush) {
120	                    SyntheticBrush.PEN -> StockBrushes.pressurePen()
121	                    SyntheticBrush.MARKER -> StockBrushes.marker()
122	                    SyntheticBrush.HIGHLIGHTER -> StockBrushes.highlighter()
123	                }
124	            val inputs = MutableStrokeInputBatch()
125	            for (i in xsPt.indices) {
126	                inputs.add(
127	                    type = InputToolType.STYLUS,
128	                    x = xsPt[i],
129	                    y = ysPt[i],
130	                    elapsedTimeMillis = i * SAMPLE_INTERVAL_MS,
131	                    pressure = pressures[i],
132	                )
133	            }
134	            return Stroke(Brush.createWithColorIntArgb(family, argb, sizePt, BRUSH_EPSILON_PT), inputs)
135	        }
136	    }
137	}

2	
3	import kotlin.math.ceil
4	import kotlin.math.floor
5	import kotlin.math.log2
6	import kotlin.math.pow
7	
8	/** Inclusive tile index ranges; empty when [txMax] < [txMin] or [tyMax] < [tyMin]. */
9	internal data class TileRange(
10	    val txMin: Int,
11	    val txMax: Int,
12	    val tyMin: Int,
13	    val tyMax: Int,
14	) {
15	    val isEmpty: Boolean get() = txMax < txMin || tyMax < tyMin
16	
17	    fun contains(
18	        tx: Int,
19	        ty: Int,
20	    ): Boolean = tx in txMin..txMax && ty in tyMin..tyMax
21	}
22	
23	/**
24	 * Tile addressing for the P01-S2 spike (05-canvas-rendering.md#viewport, #tiles): zoom buckets in
25	 * steps of sqrt 2, the bucket at or above the current scale, 512 px tiles in bucket pixels.
26	 */
27	internal object TileMath {
28	    const val TILE_PX = 512
29	
30	    /** Index of the smallest bucket `2^(i/2)` >= [scale] (px per pt). */
31	    fun bucketIndex(scale: Float): Int = ceil(2.0 * log2(scale.toDouble()) - EPSILON).toInt()
32	
33	    /** Scale (px per pt) of bucket [index]. */
34	    fun bucketScale(index: Int): Float = 2.0.pow(index / 2.0).toFloat()
35	
36	    /**
37	     * Tiles of a [pageWidthPt] x [pageHeightPt] page at [bucketScale] that intersect a
38	     * [viewWidthPx] x [viewHeightPx] view showing the page at [scale] with its origin at
39	     * ([offsetXPx], [offsetYPx]), widened by [ring] tiles and clamped to the page.
40	     */
41	    @Suppress("LongParameterList") // plain numbers keep the math testable without a Viewport type (P03)
42	    fun visibleTiles(
43	        pageWidthPt: Float,
44	        pageHeightPt: Float,
45	        scale: Float,
46	        offsetXPx: Float,
47	        offsetYPx: Float,
48	        viewWidthPx: Int,
49	        viewHeightPx: Int,
50	        bucketScale: Float,
51	        ring: Int = 0,
52	    ): TileRange {
53	        val toBucket = bucketScale / scale // view px -> bucket px
54	        val left = -offsetXPx * toBucket
55	        val top = -offsetYPx * toBucket
56	        val right = (viewWidthPx - offsetXPx) * toBucket
57	        val bottom = (viewHeightPx - offsetYPx) * toBucket
58	        val lastTx = ceil(pageWidthPt * bucketScale / TILE_PX).toInt() - 1
59	        val lastTy = ceil(pageHeightPt * bucketScale / TILE_PX).toInt() - 1
60	        return TileRange(
61	            txMin = (floor(left / TILE_PX).toInt() - ring).coerceAtLeast(0),
62	            txMax = (ceil(right / TILE_PX).toInt() - 1 + ring).coerceAtMost(lastTx),
63	            tyMin = (floor(top / TILE_PX).toInt() - ring).coerceAtLeast(0),
64	            tyMax = (ceil(bottom / TILE_PX).toInt() - 1 + ring).coerceAtMost(lastTy),
65	        )
66	    }
67	
68	    /** Tiles of [range] ordered by distance of their centers from the view center (center-out). */
69	    fun centerOut(
70	        range: TileRange,
71	        centerXBucketPx: Float,
72	        centerYBucketPx: Float,
73	    ): List<Pair<Int, Int>> {
74	        if (range.isEmpty) return emptyList()
75	        val tiles = ArrayList<Pair<Int, Int>>()
76	        for (ty in range.tyMin..range.tyMax) for (tx in range.txMin..range.txMax) tiles += tx to ty
77	        val half = TILE_PX / 2f
78	        return tiles.sortedBy { (tx, ty) ->
79	            val dx = tx * TILE_PX + half - centerXBucketPx
80	            val dy = ty * TILE_PX + half - centerYBucketPx
81	            dx * dx + dy * dy
82	        }
83	    }
84	
85	    private const val EPSILON = 1e-6
86	}

package dev.folio.app.spikes

import kotlin.math.ceil
import kotlin.math.floor
import kotlin.math.log2
import kotlin.math.pow

/** Inclusive tile index ranges; empty when [txMax] < [txMin] or [tyMax] < [tyMin]. */
internal data class TileRange(
    val txMin: Int,
    val txMax: Int,
    val tyMin: Int,
    val tyMax: Int,
) {
    val isEmpty: Boolean get() = txMax < txMin || tyMax < tyMin

    fun contains(
        tx: Int,
        ty: Int,
    ): Boolean = tx in txMin..txMax && ty in tyMin..tyMax
}

/**
 * Tile addressing for the P01-S2 spike (05-canvas-rendering.md#viewport, #tiles): zoom buckets in
 * steps of sqrt 2, the bucket at or above the current scale, 512 px tiles in bucket pixels.
 */
internal object TileMath {
    const val TILE_PX = 512

    /** Index of the smallest bucket `2^(i/2)` >= [scale] (px per pt). */
    fun bucketIndex(scale: Float): Int = ceil(2.0 * log2(scale.toDouble()) - EPSILON).toInt()

    /** Scale (px per pt) of bucket [index]. */
    fun bucketScale(index: Int): Float = 2.0.pow(index / 2.0).toFloat()

    /**
     * Tiles of a [pageWidthPt] x [pageHeightPt] page at [bucketScale] that intersect a
     * [viewWidthPx] x [viewHeightPx] view showing the page at [scale] with its origin at
     * ([offsetXPx], [offsetYPx]), widened by [ring] tiles and clamped to the page.
     */
    @Suppress("LongParameterList") // plain numbers keep the math testable without a Viewport type (P03)
    fun visibleTiles(
        pageWidthPt: Float,
        pageHeightPt: Float,
        scale: Float,
        offsetXPx: Float,
        offsetYPx: Float,
        viewWidthPx: Int,
        viewHeightPx: Int,
        bucketScale: Float,
        ring: Int = 0,
    ): TileRange {
        val toBucket = bucketScale / scale // view px -> bucket px
        val left = -offsetXPx * toBucket
        val top = -offsetYPx * toBucket
        val right = (viewWidthPx - offsetXPx) * toBucket
        val bottom = (viewHeightPx - offsetYPx) * toBucket
        val lastTx = ceil(pageWidthPt * bucketScale / TILE_PX).toInt() - 1
        val lastTy = ceil(pageHeightPt * bucketScale / TILE_PX).toInt() - 1
        return TileRange(
            txMin = (floor(left / TILE_PX).toInt() - ring).coerceAtLeast(0),
            txMax = (ceil(right / TILE_PX).toInt() - 1 + ring).coerceAtMost(lastTx),
            tyMin = (floor(top / TILE_PX).toInt() - ring).coerceAtLeast(0),
            tyMax = (ceil(bottom / TILE_PX).toInt() - 1 + ring).coerceAtMost(lastTy),
        )
    }

    /** Tiles of [range] ordered by distance of their centers from the view center (center-out). */
    fun centerOut(
        range: TileRange,
        centerXBucketPx: Float,
        centerYBucketPx: Float,
    ): List<Pair<Int, Int>> {
        if (range.isEmpty) return emptyList()
        val tiles = ArrayList<Pair<Int, Int>>()
        for (ty in range.tyMin..range.tyMax) for (tx in range.txMin..range.txMax) tiles += tx to ty
        val half = TILE_PX / 2f
        return tiles.sortedBy { (tx, ty) ->
            val dx = tx * TILE_PX + half - centerXBucketPx
            val dy = ty * TILE_PX + half - centerYBucketPx
            dx * dx + dy * dy
        }
    }

    private const val EPSILON = 1e-6
}

23	 * college-ruled page. Deterministic for a seed. Mix: 60% pen, 25% marker, 15% highlighter.

25	internal object SyntheticStrokes {
26	    const val SEED = 20260927L
27	    const val COUNT = 1500
28	
29	    fun generate(
30	        widthPt: Float,
31	        heightPt: Float,
32	        count: Int = COUNT,
33	        seed: Long = SEED,
34	    ): List<SyntheticStroke> {
35	        val random = Random(seed)
36	        return List(count) { stroke(random, widthPt, heightPt) }
37	    }

39	    private fun stroke(
40	        random: Random,
41	        widthPt: Float,
42	        heightPt: Float,
43	    ): SyntheticStroke {
44	        val roll = random.nextFloat()
45	        val brush =
46	            when {
47	                roll < PEN_SHARE -> SyntheticBrush.PEN
48	                roll < PEN_SHARE + MARKER_SHARE -> SyntheticBrush.MARKER
49	                else -> SyntheticBrush.HIGHLIGHTER
50	            }
51	        val sizePt =
52	            when (brush) {
53	                SyntheticBrush.PEN -> random.range(PEN_MIN_PT, PEN_MAX_PT)
54	                SyntheticBrush.MARKER -> random.range(MARKER_MIN_PT, MARKER_MAX_PT)
55	                SyntheticBrush.HIGHLIGHTER -> random.range(HIGHLIGHTER_MIN_PT, HIGHLIGHTER_MAX_PT)
56	            }
57	        val argb =
58	            when (brush) {
59	                SyntheticBrush.HIGHLIGHTER -> HIGHLIGHTER_COLORS[random.nextInt(HIGHLIGHTER_COLORS.size)]
60	                else -> INK_COLORS[random.nextInt(INK_COLORS.size)]
61	            }
62	        val n = random.nextInt(MIN_POINTS, MAX_POINTS + 1)
63	        val xs = FloatArray(n)
64	        val ys = FloatArray(n)
65	        val pressures = FloatArray(n)
66	        val margin = sizePt + EDGE_PT
67	        var x = random.range(margin, widthPt - margin)
68	        var y = random.range(margin, heightPt - margin)
69	        var heading = random.range(-HEADING_SPREAD, HEADING_SPREAD) // mostly left to right
70	        val stepPt = random.range(STEP_MIN_PT, STEP_MAX_PT)
71	        for (i in 0 until n) {

73	            ys[i] = y

75	            heading += random.range(-TURN, TURN)

77	            y = (y + stepPt * sin(heading)).coerceIn(margin, heightPt - margin)

7	/** Accumulates per-pixel differences between two ARGB images (P01-S2 visual equality check). */
8	internal class PixelDiff(
9	    private val threshold: Int = DEFAULT_THRESHOLD,
10	) {
11	    var pixels = 0L
12	        private set
13	    var differing = 0L
14	        private set
15	    private var channelSum = 0L
16	
17	    /** Percentage of pixels whose largest channel difference exceeds the threshold. */
18	    val differingPct: Double get() = if (pixels == 0L) 0.0 else differing * PERCENT / pixels
19	
20	    /** Mean absolute difference per color channel, 0..255. */
21	    val meanChannelDiff: Double get() = if (pixels == 0L) 0.0 else channelSum.toDouble() / (pixels * CHANNELS)
22	
23	    /** Adds the first [count] pixels of [a] and [b]. */
24	    fun add(
25	        a: IntArray,
26	        b: IntArray,
27	        count: Int = a.size,
28	    ) {
29	        for (i in 0 until count) {
30	            val dr = abs((a[i] shr RED and BYTE) - (b[i] shr RED and BYTE))
31	            val dg = abs((a[i] shr GREEN and BYTE) - (b[i] shr GREEN and BYTE))
32	            val db = abs((a[i] and BYTE) - (b[i] and BYTE))
33	            channelSum += dr + dg + db
34	            if (max(dr, max(dg, db)) > threshold) differing++
35	        }
36	        pixels += count
37	    }
38	
39	    /** Compares two same-sized bitmaps row by row. */
40	    fun addBitmaps(
41	        a: Bitmap,
42	        b: Bitmap,
43	    ): PixelDiff {
44	        require(a.width == b.width && a.height == b.height) { "bitmap sizes differ" }
45	        val rowA = IntArray(a.width)
46	        val rowB = IntArray(a.width)
47	        for (y in 0 until a.height) {
48	            a.getPixels(rowA, 0, a.width, 0, y, a.width, 1)
49	            b.getPixels(rowB, 0, b.width, 0, y, b.width, 1)
50	            add(rowA, rowB)
51	        }
52	        return this
53	    }
54	
55	    private companion object {
56	        const val DEFAULT_THRESHOLD = 32
57	        const val RED = 16
58	        const val GREEN = 8
59	        const val BYTE = 0xFF
60	        const val CHANNELS = 3
61	        const val PERCENT = 100.0
62	    }

docs/notes/gotchas.md:7:## Robolectric on JDK 21 needs module flags
docs/notes/gotchas.md:8:Robolectric (SDK 36 sandbox) reflects into `java.io.FileDescriptor` via `jdk.internal.access`; without `--add-opens java.base/java.io` and `--add-exports java.base/jdk.internal.access` it fails with "Failed to interact with raw FileDescriptor internals". `folio.screenshot` sets both.
docs/notes/gotchas.md:10:## Robolectric SDK pin per module
docs/notes/gotchas.md:11:Robolectric 4.17 supports up to SDK 36 while targetSdk is 37. Every module that applies `folio.screenshot` needs `src/test/resources/robolectric.properties` with `sdk=36` (see :app) until Robolectric supports 37.
17:- Reason: `core:model` and `core:format` are JVM modules and must depend on `core:common` and use `core:testing` in tests; a JVM module cannot depend on an Android library. Both modules only hold pure Kotlin APIs (Android sinks for FolioLog/PerfMonitor tracing live in :app). A toolchain of 17 needs a JDK 17 install or network auto-provisioning; only JDK 21 is installed (env.md). AGP 9.4.1 defaults to build-tools 36.0.0, which is not installed and would trigger a license-bearing download.
20:## A-003 2026-09-27 P00-T06: PerfMonitor traces through a TraceSink; Roborazzi plugin via build-logic
21:- Change: `PerfMonitor` (JVM core:common) emits trace sections through a `TraceSink` interface; :app installs a sink backed by platform `android.os.Trace` instead of androidx.tracing. Release keeps only the trace calls (`PerfMonitor.enabled = BuildConfig.DEBUG`). The Roborazzi Gradle plugin is loaded from build-logic's classpath (Maven Central artifact) instead of the `plugins {}` block.
32:- Reason: a frame callback posted after `invalidate()` runs in the animation phase of the same vsync, before that frame's draw, so it removes wet ink before the committed layer has drawn it (breaks "never remove earlier"). The commit callback fires after the frame is submitted: `ink:handoff` p50 6.4 ms (about one 120 Hz frame), all post-stroke screenshots clean (decisions.md ADR-002 evidence).

content.content:
1	# Device: Xiaomi Pad 7
2	Filled by P00-T02, P01-S1, P01-S7 and later discoveries. Known from Xiaomi specs (unverified on this unit until probed): 11.2" 3200x2136, up to 144 Hz; Focus Pen 8192 pressure levels, 240 Hz sampling, three buttons bound to HyperOS functions (spotlight, screenshot, writing); tilt not listed in official specs.
3	
4	## Identity
5	- Model 2410CRP4CG, device codename `uke`, adb serial `2b6e1b3e` (USB)
6	- Android 16, SDK 36, HyperOS OS3.0 (build OS3.0.303.0.WOZEUXM, EEA)
7	- minSdk for Folio: 35 (= min(35, 36); ADR-012 note 2026-09-27)
8	
9	## Display
10	- Physical 2136x3200 (natural orientation portrait per `wm size`), density 440 dpi
11	- Refresh modes (fps): 30, 48, 50, 60, 90, 120, 144
12	- Editor mode: request the fastest mode (144 Hz, mode id 2) via `preferredDisplayModeId` (`DisplayModeHelper`). P01-S1: the active mode stayed 120 Hz, idle and inking (`diag.sh refresh`: `peakRefreshRate=120`); probably the HyperOS refresh-rate setting caps apps (USER-CHECK). Frame budgets at 120 Hz: 8.3 ms.
13	- Usual orientation while testing: landscape, rotation 1 (3200x2136)
14	
15	## Input
16	- Touch: `NVTCapacitiveTouchScreen`
17	- Pen digitizer: `NVTCapacitivePenM80p` and `NVTCapacitivePenP81c` (sources KEYBOARD | TOUCHSCREEN | STYLUS)
18	- Focus Pen BT companions: `Xiaomi Focus Pen`, `Xiaomi Focus Pen Keyboard`, `Xiaomi Focus Pen Mouse`
19	- System window `stylus-handwriting-event-receiver-0` is a SPY with INTERCEPTS_STYLUS over the full screen (Android stylus handwriting); watch for it in P01-S7
20	- Touch sample rate: not measured yet
21	
22	## Stylus
23	(from the P01-S7 probe: pressure range, tilt yes/no + range, orientation, hover yes/no, buttons delivered to apps, sample rate, synthetic `input stylus` limitations)
24	
25	## Rendering
26	- Front-buffered wet ink works: InProgressStrokesView adds `SurfaceView[...](BLAST)` (z=1) above the app window on the first stroke and keeps it; `screencap` captures it (P01-S1).
27	- Wet-ink main-thread cost `ink:onTouch` p95 0.28 ms; wet-to-dry handoff one frame (decisions.md ADR-002 evidence).
28	- HWUI logs `E/HWUI [m2] set surface nullptr` about once per wet-ink frame; harmless noise.
29	- Synthetic `input stylus swipe` of 400 ms delivers 50 MotionEvents; gfxinfo flags ~80% of those frames "High input latency" (likely an artifact of injected event timestamps).
30	
31	## Quirks
32	- adb installs fail with `INSTALL_FAILED_USER_RESTRICTED: Install canceled by user` unless Developer options > "Install via USB" is on (HyperOS may require a Mi account sign-in). Prompts on screen need a tap.
33	- The separate test APK (`dev.folio.notes.debug.test`, instrumented tests) also needs "USB debugging (Security settings)" (Mi account sign-in); without it only the app APK installs. Both enabled 2026-09-27.
34	- `pm uninstall` of a package that is not installed returns `DELETE_FAILED_INTERNAL_ERROR` (harmless).
35	- Our process logs HyperOS framework noise at start (E/ `MI-PreRender`, `FramePredict`, `FrameInsert`); ignore when scanning logcat.
36	- System locale de_DE and system dark mode on (the P00 placeholder renders light; dark UI arrives in P11).

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# Connect to the tablet: .device/target (ip:port) -> mDNS discovery -> single USB device.
3	source "$(dirname "$0")/_common.sh"
4	target=""
5	if [ -f "$STATE_DIR/target" ]; then target="$(tr -d '\r\n' < "$STATE_DIR/target")"; fi
6	if [ -z "$target" ]; then
7	  target="$("$ADB_BIN" mdns services 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r' | awk '/_adb-tls-connect/ {print $NF}' | head -n1 || true)"
8	fi
9	rm -f "$STATE_DIR/serial"
10	if [ -n "$target" ]; then
11	  "$ADB_BIN" connect "$target" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r' | tail -n1
12	  echo "$target" > "$STATE_DIR/serial"
13	fi
14	init_device
15	echo "Connected: $SERIAL ($(dshell getprop ro.product.model))"
16

content.content:
1	# 07 Text engine
2	Typed text is Markdown, laid out on the page grid so that every line sits on the template's rules, for every font, with inline LaTeX, at every zoom level. Module `core:text` (layout, parsing, fonts, math) + `feature:editor` (editing UI).
3	
4	## Grid unit
5	- U (points) comes from the page template (05-canvas-rendering.md#templates): rule spacing, grid cell, dot spacing, or the blank/custom default.
6	- Grid origin: y0 = template `marginTopPt`; rule lines at y0 + n*U. Horizontal grid columns (grid/dotted/graph templates) at x0 + m*U; lined templates have no column snapping except the margin line.
7	- `GridUnit.of(template)` is the single source for U and the grid origin. Changing the template spacing re-flows text on that page (line counts change, content never overlaps).
8	
9	## Line box
10	- Every text line occupies a line box of height k*U (k = 1 for body text, 2 for H1/H2). Line boxes are stacked without gaps; paragraph gaps are whole empty lines.
11	- The baseline of a line is the rule at the bottom of its line box. Descenders extend below the rule into the next box (like handwriting on ruled paper).
12	- Implementation: Compose text with `TextStyle(lineHeight = k*U, lineHeightStyle = LineHeightStyle(Alignment.Bottom, Trim.None))`. With bottom alignment, baseline = lineBottom - descent(font, size). The renderer shifts the block by `baselineCorrection = descent` (from `FontMetricsCache`) so baselines land exactly on rules. No placement decision ever uses the font's ascent.
13	- Layout happens at a fixed reference scale (4 px per pt) with linear (unhinted, subpixel) glyph metrics, so line breaks do not change with zoom. Drawing scales the canvas.
14	- Invariant (tested): for every line, |baselineY - (y0 + n*U)| <= 0.5 px at zoom 1, 2, 4, and every line box height is an integer multiple of U.
15	
16	## Font normalization
17	- Fonts differ in em-box proportions. Size is therefore derived, not chosen in sp: `sizePx = targetCapHeight / capRatio(typeface)` where `capRatio` = cap height ("H" bounds) / size, measured once per typeface and cached in `FontMetricsCache`.
18	- Target cap heights (fraction of U): body S 0.38, M 0.45 (default), L 0.52; H1 0.95 (2U box); H2 0.75 (2U box); H3 0.55 bold (1U box); code 0.40 (monospace); table cells = body; sticky notes = body.
19	- The user picks S/M/L per flow and a font family per flow. Mixed fonts inside a flow: code spans use the monospace family, math uses the math renderer; all share the line box.
20	
21	## Fonts
22	Bundled (OFL, downloaded from github.com/google/fonts in P01-S3, licenses shipped in assets/licenses): regular, italic, bold, bold italic where available; variable fonts where Google publishes them.
23	| Group | Families |
24	|---|---|
25	| Sans | Inter, IBM Plex Sans, Source Sans 3, Nunito, Lexend, Atkinson Hyperlegible Next (or Atkinson Hyperlegible), Noto Sans |
26	| Serif | Source Serif 4, Lora, Merriweather, EB Garamond, Crimson Pro, Literata |
27	| Mono | JetBrains Mono, IBM Plex Mono |
28	| Handwriting | Caveat, Patrick Hand, Kalam, Architects Daughter, Shadows Into Light |
29	Default text font: Inter. Custom fonts: import `.ttf/.otf` via the system file picker; copied to app storage and mirrored into the library folder `.fonts/` so other devices can install them; documents reference fonts by family name with fallback to Inter. UI fonts (Inter, Fraunces) live separately in core:designsystem.
30	
31	## Blocks

- Invariant (tested): for every line, |baselineY - (y0 + n*U)| <= 0.5 px at zoom 1, 2, 4, and every line box height is an integer multiple of U.

## Font normalization
- Fonts differ in em-box proportions. Size is therefore derived, not chosen in sp: `sizePx = targetCapHeight / capRatio(typeface)` where `capRatio` = cap height ("H" bounds) / size, measured once per typeface and cached in `FontMetricsCache`.
- Target cap heights (fraction of U): body S 0.38, M 0.45 (default), L 0.52; H1 0.95 (2U box); H2 0.75 (2U box); H3 0.55 bold (1U box); code 0.40 (monospace); table cells = body; sticky notes = body.
- The user picks S/M/L per flow and a font family per flow. Mixed fonts inside a flow: code spans use the monospace family, math uses the math renderer; all share the line box.

## Fonts
Bundled (OFL, downloaded from github.com/google/fonts in P01-S3, licenses shipped in assets/licenses): regular, italic, bold, bold italic where available; variable fonts where Google publishes them.
| Group | Families |
|---|---|
| Sans | Inter, IBM Plex Sans, Source Sans 3, Nunito, Lexend, Atkinson Hyperlegible Next (or Atkinson Hyperlegible), Noto Sans |
| Serif | Source Serif 4, Lora, Merriweather, EB Garamond, Crimson Pro, Literata |
| Mono | JetBrains Mono, IBM Plex Mono |
| Handwriting | Caveat, Patrick Hand, Kalam, Architects Daughter, Shadows Into Light |
Default text font: Inter. Custom fonts: import `.ttf/.otf` via the system file picker; copied to app storage and mirrored into the library folder `.fonts/` so other devices can install them; documents reference fonts by family name with fallback to Inter. UI fonts (Inter, Fraunces) live separately in core:designsystem.

## ADR-008 Text layout engine
Status: Proposed (decided by P01-S3)
Context: Every line must snap to template lines regardless of font (R-TXT-03); long text must stay fast (R-TXT-05); Notewise's slow text-box workflow must not repeat (R-CORE-01).
Options: A Compose text per block with fixed line boxes + per-font baseline correction + cap-height normalization, block-based editing with a single live field; B one BasicTextField per flow (simple, but slow for long text and hard to snap); C fully custom text layout + IME (maximum control, very high cost).
Decision (default): A. Spike fallback: per-line placement from TextLayoutResult metrics if baseline error exceeds 0.5 px.
Consequences: cross-block selection needs custom handling; the focused block shows Markdown markers dimmed (no hidden characters).

## ADR-009 Index and search
12:| `core:text` | Android library | Markdown block parser, FontRegistry, FontMetricsCache, BlockLayout, FlowLayout, MathRenderer adapters |
13-| `core:render` | Android library | Viewport, PageStackLayout, TemplateRenderer, tile caches, BitmapPool, PageRenderer, DisplayModeHelper |
14-| `core:pdf` | Android library | PdfRasterizer, PDF import, PdfExporter strategies, PNG export |
15-| `core:designsystem` | Android library | Tokens, FolioTheme, UI fonts, FolioIcons (generated), shared components |
16-| `core:testing` | JVM (A-002) | Fakes, rules, builders, fixtures helpers (testImplementation only) |
17-| `feature:library` | Android library | Onboarding, library home, folders, tags, search, bin, new-note entry |

## Templates
All templates are vector-drawn, aligned to the grid origin (x0 = 0 or left margin, y0 = marginTopPt), repeat infinitely on infinite pages, and use line color `#C9D3E0` by default (dots `#B8C0CC`, margin line `#F2A6A6`).
| Kind | Default geometry | Grid unit U |
|---|---|---|
| BLANK | nothing drawn | 7.0 mm (19.84 pt) |
| LINED narrow / college / wide | horizontal rules every 6.0 / 7.1 / 8.7 mm; top margin 25 mm; red margin line at 25 mm from left (option) | rule spacing |
| GRID | 5 mm squares (options 4, 5, 7 mm) | cell size |
| DOTTED | dots every 5 mm (options 4, 5, 7 mm), 1.2 pt diameter | dot spacing |
| CORNELL | college rules; cue column 63.5 mm (left), summary area 50.8 mm (bottom) separated by 1 pt lines; three text zones | 7.1 mm |
| GRAPH_AXES | 5 mm grid, every 5th line darker, x/y axes through the page center | 5 mm |
| MUSIC_STAFF | staves of 5 lines 2 mm apart, 10 staves per A4 portrait, scaled for other sizes | 7.0 mm (text only in margins) |
| PLANNER_DAILY | date header, hour rows 06:00-22:00 with labels in a 15 mm gutter, notes column | 7.1 mm |
| PLANNER_WEEKLY | week header, 7 day boxes (2 columns + notes box), lined interiors | 7.1 mm |
| CUSTOM | PNG or PDF page asset scaled to the page; user sets U (default 7.1 mm) | user value |
Spacing presets are selectable per page (page settings sheet). Text zones (body frames) per template are defined in 07-text-engine.md#flows-and-frames.

## Tiles
## Rendering
- `BlockLayout` = reference-scale layout of one block for a given width + style key + U: line ranges, line box heights, placeholder rects (math, checkboxes), baseline correction. Cached (LRU, key = block text hash + width + style + U).
- `FlowLayout` = distribution result: per frame, the list of (block, first line, last line, y offset in U).
- Unfocused blocks are painted by `PageRenderer` into content tiles from `BlockLayout`s (Compose `Paragraph.paint` on the tile canvas with scale), then math and checkboxes are drawn at their placeholder rects.
- Invalidation after an edit: the edited block; if its line count changed, every following line in that frame and later frames (tile invalidation by rect).
- Layout of blocks for newly visible pages runs on the `text` dispatcher, visible-first; never on the main thread except for the focused block.

## Editing

## Viewport
- `Viewport` state: `scale` (px per pt), `offsetPx` (document origin in view px), `mode` = `Stack` (fixed pages in a vertical column) or `Canvas(pageId)` (one infinite page, free 2D).
- `PageStackLayout`: pages in one vertical column, centered horizontally, 16 dp gap, 24 dp side padding. Page tops are prefix sums; lookups by binary search. Infinite pages appear in the stack as a card sized to their content bounds (min: origin size) with a "canvas" badge; tapping enters Canvas mode.
- Fit-width scale = (viewWidth - 48 dp) / widest page width. Zoom range 0.2x..8x of fit-width. Default on open: fit-width, first page top (or last position, stored per document in DataStore).
- Zoom buckets for tile resolution: `bucketScale = 2^(round(2*log2(scale))/2)` (steps of sqrt 2). Tiles render at the bucket at or above the current scale.
- Focal-point zoom keeps the document point under the pinch center fixed. Pan is clamped in Stack mode (half a screen of overscroll), unclamped in Canvas mode.
- All pt <-> px conversions live in `Viewport` (`toViewPx`, `toPagePt`, `visibleRectPt(pageId)`).
